# Pinned browser libraries

Leaflet 1.9.4 and Leaflet-MiniMap 3.6.1 are served from this site. Runtime JavaScript, CSS, images, licenses and the minified source map are
unmodified. Punctuation is normalized in comments in the optional debug source
bundles and their embedded source-map text; their updated hashes are recorded. No npm installation or build step runs in the browser.

Sources: https://registry.npmjs.org/leaflet/1.9.4 and
https://registry.npmjs.org/leaflet-minimap/3.6.1 .
Package integrity was verified before extraction. `manifest.json` records
SHA-256 hashes of the extracted files; `node scripts/check-release.cjs`
verifies them and the local map asset manifest before publishing.
